description: A runtime description of data that validates input and infers a TypeScript type with `z.infer`.
Validates without throwing; returns `{ success: true, data }` or `{ success: false, error }` with `error.issues`.
Adds a custom check. On objects, `path` targets the field that should show the message.
VeeValidate's schema interface: `{ __type: 'VVTypedSchema', parse }`. Adapters like `@vee-validate/zod` implement it.
A shared interface implemented by Zod 4, Valibot and ArkType so tools can accept any of them.
